reason: The product is worked granite in slabs with a polished surface and beveled edges, classified under HTS 6802.23.00.00 as 'Granite' in 'Other monumental or building stone and articles thereof, simply cut or sawn, with a flat or even surface.'
The product is a worked natural stone (Piracema White) simply cut or sawn with a flat or even (polished) surface, falling under heading 6802's 'Other stone' subheading 6802.29.90.00.
The product functions as a rubber vulcanizing agent (prepared rubber accelerator) containing an aromatic substance, specifically classified under 3812.10.10.00.

The product is an insulated electric conductor fitted with connectors (3.5mm stereo receptacle and multi-pin connector) for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 V, specifically classified under 8544.42.90.90 as 'Other' fitted with connectors.

The cables are insulated electric conductors fitted with connectors, for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 V, and do not meet the specific criteria for coaxial cables or telecommunications use, classifying them under 8544.42.90.90.

The costume is classified under 9505.90.60.00 as a festive article due to its flimsy construction, unfinished edges, and inclusion of accessories like Tarot cards, consistent with the heading's terms for entertainment articles.
The blouse is made of a man-made, loose-weave textile fabric (non-knitted), classifying it under 6206.40.30.35 as a women's blouse of man-made fibers, not knitted or crocheted.
The polished steel balls are precision radial ball bearings, single row, with a nominal diameter fitting the 9 mm and over but not over 30 mm range, as specified in heading 8482.10.50.44.
The products are preparations of a kind used in animal feeding, specifically for poultry, as described in HTS heading 2309 and its notes.
The product is a cosmetic skincare device with LEDs and adhesive backing, falling under 'other perfumery, cosmetic or toilet preparations, not elsewhere specified or included' in heading 3307.
The product is a made-up textile article (cotton fabric) with wooden ribs, not a mechanical fan, fitting the wording of HTS 6307.90.98.91 as 'other made up articles.'
Roflumilast is a heterocyclic compound with nitrogen hetero-atoms only, containing an unfused pyridine ring, classified under heading 2933.39.41.00 as a drug.

The product is a radiobroadcast receiver combined with sound recording or reproducing apparatus (via USB/Bluetooth playback) of a kind used in motor vehicles, specifically classified under 8527.21.40.80.
The item is a non-functional Halloween decoration, falling under the provision for 'festive articles' in HTS heading 9505.90.60.00.

Clodronic Acid Disodium Salt Tetrahydrate is an acyclic amide derivative (bisphosphonate) and its salts, classified under HTS 2924.19.80.00 as 'Other acyclic amides and their derivatives; salts thereof.'

The costume is classified under 9505.90.60.00 as a festive or entertainment article, specifically a theatrical outfit for adults, per the heading's wording 'festive, carnival or other entertainment articles.'
The product is crushed natural basalt stone without further processing, classifiable under 'Other articles' of heading 6810 as 'Other' per the terms of the heading and chapter notes.
Etripamil is a heterocyclic compound (non-dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker) classified under heading 2934 as 'other heterocyclic compounds' and specifically under 2934.99.30.00 as a drug.
The ear cup assemblies are parts of a headset, not complete headphones or earphones, fitting the wording of 8518.90.81.00 ('Parts').
The screw is made of stainless steel, has a diameter of less than 6 mm, and fits the description of 'Other screws and bolts' under HTS 7318.15.60.70.
The product is an insulated copper data cable without connectors, specifically classified under 8544.49.30.80 as 'Of copper' and 'Other' for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 V.

The product is a sweet baked good primarily made from wheat flour and classified under HTS heading 1905 as 'bread, pastry, cakes, biscuits and other bakers' wares,' specifically 1905.90.10.50 for 'pastries, cakes and similar sweet baked products.'
The product is a mineral or chemical fertilizer containing the three fertilizing elements nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, meeting the terms of heading 3105.20.00.00.
The arbor is a decorative article of base metal (steel) designed for garden ornamentation, fitting the wording of HTS heading 8306.29.00.00 ('statuettes and other ornaments, of base metal').

The product is a medicament containing diclofenac sodium, a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agent, put up in measured doses for therapeutic use (pain and inflammation treatment) and classified under 3004.90.92.36 as 'Other' analgesics, antipyretics, and nonhormonal anti-inflammatory agents.
The product is a finished aluminum shower door assembly for residential bathroom use, specifically classifiable under the wording 'sanitary ware and parts thereof' in heading 7615.20.00.00.

The kit is a composite good of plastics, not elsewhere specified or included, and does not meet the specific criteria for beads (3926.90.35.00) or ornamental articles (3926.40.00), thus classified under 3926.90.99.89 as 'Other' articles of plastics.
The product is a women's disposable knitted brief of man-made fibers (polypropylene) designed for one-time use, matching the wording of 6108.22.10.00.

The product is a craft kit primarily composed of plastic beads and thread for creating jewelry, classified under 3926.90.35.00 as 'Beads, bugles and spangles, not strung (except temporarily) and not set; articles thereof, not elsewhere specified or included.'

The product is a prepared meal containing seafood (shrimp and clams) and rice, classifiable under 1605.29.05.00 as 'Products containing fish meat; prepared meals' per the heading and Chapter 16 Note 1(b).
The Lada Niva is a used motor vehicle principally designed for the transport of persons, with a 1.7-liter spark-ignition engine, fitting the description of subheading 8703.22.01.90 ('Used').

The knit bralette is classified as a women's top of man-made fibers under heading 6114.30.10.20, as it is neither a blouse (6106) nor a brassiere (6212) per the chapter notes and design characteristics.
The costume is a festive article designed for theatrical or themed events, classifiable under HTS 9505.90.60.00 as per the heading's terms and prior CBP rulings (e.g., N327405).

The goods are free-standing storage racks of steel, classifiable under HTSUS heading 9403.20.00.82 as 'steel racks, other than those described in statistical reporting number 9403.20.0075,' per Chapter 94, Note 1 and the terms of the heading.

The GripVR is a radio remote control apparatus specifically designed for use with virtual reality headsets, fitting the wording of HTS 8526.92.10.00 ('Radio remote control apparatus for video game consoles').
The product is a gear-type rotary positive displacement pump, as described by the two gears with shafts inside an aluminum casing, fitting the wording of 8413.60.00.30 ('Gear type').

The product consists of preserved natural flowers treated and prepared for ornamental purposes, fitting the wording of HTS heading 0603: 'Cut flowers and flower buds of a kind suitable for bouquets or for ornamental purposes... dried, dyed, bleached, impregnated or otherwise prepared.'
The product is a festive article specifically designed for seasonal Halloween use, falling under the wording of heading 9505 as 'festive...entertainment articles.'
The product is a transistor with a dissipation rate of less than 1 W (minimum 0.7 W, maximum 1.1 W), classifying it under 8541.21.00 as 'With a dissipation rate of less than 1 W'.

The kit is classifiable under 9615.11.50.00 as 'Combs, hair-slides and the like... of hard rubber or plastics' because the primary components (hair clips) are plastic and designed for hair decoration, with the tweezers and stickers being incidental.
The tote bag has an outer surface of plastic sheeting and is designed for multipurpose use as a handbag or similar container, fitting the wording of HTS 4202.22.15.00.
The product is an upholstered sectional sofa with a wooden frame, not convertible into a bed, classifying under 9401.61.60.31 as 'Other seats, with wooden frames, upholstered, other.'

The product is a fitted carry case with an outer surface of man-made textile materials, specifically classified under 'Trunks, suitcases, vanity cases, attache cases, briefcases, school satchels and similar containers' per HTS heading 4202.12.81.70.
The product is an article of ABS plastic, not elsewhere specified or included, fitting the description of 'Other articles of plastics' under HTS 3926.90.99.89.

The product consists of stuffed pasta (dumplings with pastry wrappers and vegetable/cheese fillings), which falls under HTS heading 1902.20.00 as 'Stuffed pasta, whether or not cooked or otherwise prepared.'
The product is a tote bag with an outer surface of plastic sheeting, specifically classified under 4202.22.15.00 as a handbag with outer surface of sheeting of plastics.

The Pulse 2.0 Logic Board is an electrical apparatus with an individual function (network communication subsystem for industrial energy monitoring) not specified elsewhere in Chapter 85, falling under HTS 8543.70.45.00.

The device is a digital signal processor specifically designed for audio signal processing in loudspeaker systems, fitting the wording of 8543.70.91.00: 'Digital signal processing apparatus capable of connecting to a wired or wireless network for the mixing of sound.'

The product is a gas-fired condensing hydronic boiler designed for commercial and industrial heating applications, specifically classifiable under heading 8403 as 'Central heating boilers (other than those of heading 8402) and parts thereof.'

The product is a made-up textile article (cotton tubular braid) used as a furnishing article (wall decoration), classifiable under HTS 6304.92.00.00 as 'Other furnishing articles...not knitted or crocheted, of cotton.'
The product is a solid bath bar primarily composed of sodium bicarbonate, which is specifically named in heading 2836.30.00.00 as 'Sodium hydrogencarbonate (Sodium bicarbonate)'.
The vehicle is a used passenger car with a 1,994 cc spark-ignition internal combustion engine, classifying it under 8703.23.01.90 as per the heading terms and engine capacity.

The product is a steel container with a capacity of 50 liters or more, designed to hold liquid refrigerant (not compressed or liquefied gas), fitting the wording of HTS 7310.10.00.90 for 'Other' containers.
The product is a threaded article of steel with a specific function as a towing attachment, classifiable under heading 7318 as 'similar articles' of iron or steel.

The garments are sleeveless, pullover, knitted mesh athletic pinnies of man-made fibers, fitting the description of 'other garments' under heading 6114, which specifically covers garments not elsewhere specified.
The knee protectors are designed to provide stability and impact protection during physical activities, fitting the Chapter 90 legal note for 'orthopedic appliances' under heading 9021.
The knee board is classified under 9506.91.00.30 as it is an article for general physical exercise or outdoor use, not elsewhere specified, made of PU plastic foam and designed for kneeling support.
The product consists of loose aspen wood shavings, a vegetable plaiting material in sheet form, classifiable under heading 4601.29.60.00 as mats, matting, or screens of vegetable materials.

The product is a part of an automobile seat, specifically designed and permanently welded to the lower frame to support the seat cover, fitting the description of 'parts thereof' under HTS 9401.20.00.00.
The product is a festive Halloween decoration, specifically described under HTS 9505.90.60.00 as 'Other' festive articles.
